references.rationale: No chromestatus link or external references on the page.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 4 fail on this build without the new methods.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: loaded the innerHTML-append preset, ran Migrate, saw converted output and diff; zero console errors.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with labels, but the generated diff/output appears without announcement.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: loaded a legacy preset and clicked Migrate; converted appendHTML/setHTML code and a line-level diff rendered with migration notes; zero console errors; page lacks the ChromeStatus link.
